text:
sam: FYI — scheduling a targeted maintenance tonight for runtime kernels + model pin across EU and APAC. deploy-bot shows start at 00:30 UTC for EU. Need statuspage copy and a short customer email. Rolling by region; action matrix below.
maria: Clarify — kernels only, or are we touching model weights too?
sam: Kernels + small runtime patch. We will pin customer traffic to model_version=2.3.1 during the window to avoid mismatch. No weight changes.
lucas: Can we keep a fallback to v2.2.9 in case latency regresses?
sam: Yes. Plan: canary on small traffic -> pin -> monitor. If we see >5% latency regression, rollback to v2.2.9. deploy-bot hook will auto-fallback if smoke tests fail.
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance job 3055554321 created: canary on eu-west-1 (10% traffic) at 00:30 UTC. Will attempt gradual rollout to eu-* at 00:50 UTC if canary passes.
anya: Support — I'll draft the statuspage snippet and localized emails. Need region matrix + expected impact wording.
support-sarah: I'll QA the EU + APAC customer lists and flag any VIP tenants for pre-notify. Who should I include?
sam: DMing the top-12 enterprise tenants now. Expected impact: short 5-10m per pod for cache warmup; possible 1-2% error spike for <2 minutes. Mention minimal impact but be explicit about throttling.
maria: I'll author a rollback playbook section in the runbook (short checklist).
lucas: Add a step to revoke the new kernel on failing nodes and route traffic to dedicated pools if smoke tests fail.
statusbot: Statuspage draft (posted to #statuspage-drafts):

[STATUS PAGE SNIPPET]
Short: Planned maintenance — brief runtime kernel update in EU & APAC. Minimal customer impact expected; short request throttling while instances warm caches.
Timeline: EU start 2026-03-22 00:30 UTC, APAC start 2026-03-22 01:30 UTC (staggered)
Regions: eu-west-1, eu-central-1, ap-southeast-1, ap-northeast-1
Estimated duration per region: 10-15 minutes
Impact: transient throttling and short cache warmup latency; retry recommended by clients
Customer action: none required; reach support@redwood.ai if issues persist
Contact: support@redwood.ai and status.redwood.ai

Please review and flag wording for legal/localization.
sam: Nice. Anya — can you do an email subject + one-paragraph body, with an opt-out link for customers who need a different window?
anya: Draft subject: "Planned maintenance — brief runtime update (EU/APAC)"
Draft body: "We will perform a short maintenance to update runtime kernels in your region. The update is expected to cause brief request throttling while instances warm caches (approx. 10–15 minutes). No action is required on your side. If you need an alternate maintenance window, reply to this message or contact support@redwood.ai to opt out or reschedule."
I'll post localized versions in 15m.
support-sarah: After your approval I'll schedule the broadcast. I'll attach a rollback contact matrix with phone + pager for top-tier customers.
sam: Reminder: pin policy command (internal): `rb set-pin --version 2.3.1 --regions eu* --start 2026-03-22T00:25Z --end 2026-03-22T01:00Z`
lucas: Ack. Adding automated smoke checks: p50/p95 latency and error-rate. If p95 > 300ms OR error-rate > 1.5% -> trigger rollback.
deploy-bot: Canary passed on eu-west-1 at 00:36 UTC. Proceeding to gradual rollout.
maria: If thresholds hit, we'll mark status as "Degraded performance"; otherwise keep as "Maintenance".
sam: Post-maint action items: compile perf metrics (tokens/sec delta, token cost change) and include in post-maint notes for customers on request. I'll draft a short postmortem if any rollback occurs.
anya: Uploading localized email templates to #support-drafts in ~10m.
support-sarah: Pre-notify list sent to top-12 customers via DM and email; included exec contact and SMS option.
lucas: Target for rollback completion once decided: within 15 minutes.
sam: Thanks team — I'll update #eng-oncall with final start + links. Keep eyes on dashboards and alerts. Closing thread unless blockers. :thumbsup:
